props.title: DeForest Partners with Madison AI to Lead Wisconsin Municipalities Toward the Era of AI

photo.alt: Aerial view of the Village of DeForest, Wisconsin

blocks.text: The Village of DeForest, Wisconsin, in partnership with Madison AI, has introduced a Citywide artificial intelligence (AI) model that will help modernize Village operations. As the first municipality in Wisconsin to deploy Madison AI, the initiative is part of DeForest’s efforts to upgrade municipal technology and return valuable time to Village staff.

DeForest faces ongoing challenges in managing disconnected software systems across departments. Working with a small team, it is vital for DeForest staff to allocate resources properly and efficiently to avoid staff burnout. The Citywide assistant helps staff locate data easily in a single, centralized source to avoid the time it takes for manual research.

Managing a small municipality is a team effort. Replacing fragmented software with Madison AI’s modern Citywide model helps our staff optimize operations so we can focus on ensuring our work is accurate and effective. We are paving the way forward with impactful results for our residents.
blocks.attribution: Bill Chang, Village Administrator, Village of DeForest

photo.alt: Bill Chang, Village Administrator, Village of DeForest

blocks.text: By transitioning into Madison AI’s platform, staff will be empowered to allocate their time more efficiently without compromising quality and accuracy.

This effort demonstrates DeForest’s commitment to innovation and effective management. Small municipalities carry a lot of responsibility, and by consolidating systems into one platform, DeForest proves that local governments of all sizes can pave the way for modernizing public service.
blocks.attribution: Erica Olsen, CEO of Madison AI

photo.alt: Erica Olsen, CEO of Madison AI

blocks.text: Located 15 miles north of Madison along the Yahara River, the Village of DeForest is a growing Dane County community. DeForest serves over 11,000 residents, providing high-quality municipal services and a direct connection to the greater Madison technology and logistics corridor. Learn more about DeForest.

Madison AI is the AI engine for local government. Using enterprise data and systems of record, Madison AI’s suite of purpose-built artificial intelligence assistants is designed to support the primary internal functions of local government. These include assistants for the Office of the City Manager, Community Development, Procurement, and related operational areas. Madison AI accelerates administrative tasks, such as preparing staff reports, generating zoning verification letters, and drafting requests for proposals, using the agency’s own enterprise data to ensure accuracy and reliability. Co-founded by Washoe County and trusted by nearly 50 local governments, Madison AI supports public-sector staff by reducing administrative workload and enabling teams to direct more time to serving their communities.
